warning: Every source_quote below is the literal string TODO_VERIFY(...) on purpose.
Statutory text MUST be copied verbatim from EUR-Lex by ticket A-T04 (scripts/fetch_eurlex.py),
never typed from memory by a human or an agent. A misquoted statute in a compliance tool is fatal
to the Quality-of-the-Idea and Potential-Impact criteria.
A rule whose source_quote still starts with TODO_VERIFY is EXCLUDED from the deterministic gate at
runtime (see backend/app/gate/rules_loader.py) and the run must downgrade to AT_RISK with reason
article_ref values below are best-effort pointers from public summaries and MUST be confirmed against
the official text before use. Where the exact sub-paragraph letter is uncertain it is written as '(?)'.

primary_source.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2023/988 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 10 May 2023 on general product safety (General Product Safety Regulation, GPSR)
primary_source.related_instrument: Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 on market surveillance and compliance of products (its Article 4 defines the economic operator established in the Union responsible for the product) — CONFIRM

rules.title: The offer identifies the product (type, and batch/serial or other identifier)
rules.source_quote: TODO_VERIFY(EUR-Lex 32023R0988 Art. 19 — copy the sub-paragraph on product identification verbatim)
rules.fix_template: Add a product identifier to the listing: type plus batch, serial, model or EAN/GTIN.

rules.title: The offer names the economic operator established in the Union responsible for the product

legal_basis.article_ref: Art. 19(?) read with Art. 4 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020

rules.source_quote: TODO_VERIFY(EUR-Lex 32023R0988 Art. 19 — copy the sub-paragraph on the economic operator established in the Union verbatim; also copy Art. 4(1)/(2)/(3) of Reg. 2019/1020)
rules.fix_template: Add the name and registered trade name or registered trademark of your EU responsible person.
rules.note: This is the single most-missed field in the Commission's own 2026 sweep. It is also the field most often present on the packaging but absent from the listing — the exact failure that produced the CZK 380,000 Czech fine of 4 March 2026.

rules.title: Warnings and safety information are in a language easily understood by consumers in the destination member state

legal_basis.article_ref: Art. 9(?) / Art. 19(?) — language determined by the Member State

rules.source_quote: TODO_VERIFY(EUR-Lex 32023R0988 — the 'language easily understood by consumers, as determined by the Member State' wording, verbatim; and confirm which article carries it)
rules.note: Belgium requires nl/fr (and de for the German-speaking community); Luxembourg fr/de/lb; Finland fi/sv; Cyprus el/tr; Malta mt/en; Ireland en. Use constants.member_state_consumer_language. Where a member state has formally 'determined' a specific language by national measure, prefer that — record it in docs/LEGAL-SOURCES.md.

marketplace_mapping.amazon: Safety information → language of the marketplace
marketplace_mapping.ebay: Item specifics → language of the site

rules.title: Any EAN/GTIN published in the offer passes its checksum

legal_basis.instrument: Internal consistency check (not a statutory rule)

rules.source_quote: Deterministic check. A listing that publishes an invalid GTIN cannot be reconciled with a recall notice by barcode, which is how marketplaces match Safety Gate alerts to offers.
rules.fix_template: The published barcode {value} fails its checksum. Correct it to {suggestion_or_blank}.

rules.title: The responsible person is established in the Union (EU-27, plus EEA where applicable)

legal_basis.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 Art. 4, as referenced by GPSR

rules.source_quote: TODO_VERIFY(EUR-Lex 32019R1020 Art. 4 — copy the cascade of who may be the responsible economic operator, verbatim)
rules.fix_template: Your responsible person's address is in {country}, which is not an EU/EEA member state. Appoint an EU-based responsible person (manufacturer, importer, authorised representative, fulfilment provider, or another mandated operator).
rules.note: The cascade order matters and is the part outsiders get wrong. Confirm the exact ordering from Art. 4 of Reg. 2019/1020 before surfacing it to users.

rules.title: The generated compliance pack contains no placeholder or template text
rules.source_quote: Deterministic regex over the generated artifact. Handing a seller a pack that still says '{{responsible_person_name}}' is worse than handing them nothing.
rules.fix_template: Artifact generation incomplete: placeholders remain at {locations}.

rules.title: Context rule: after an authority order, the marketplace must act within two working days
rules.note: Not a finding. Supplies the deadline_hint text and explains WHY the marketplace acts before any authority contacts the seller — which is the mechanism most sellers do not understand.

rules.title: Context rule: penalties are set per member state; there is no EU-wide GPSR fine
rules.source_quote: TODO_VERIFY(EUR-Lex 32023R0988 Art. 44 — copy verbatim; note it sets NO figure and requires penalties to be 'effective, proportionate and dissuasive')
rules.note: National ceilings must be sourced per country from the national implementing act and refreshed by the Tavily live check at runtime — never hard-coded from a blog. The widely repeated '4% of worldwide turnover' figure has NO source in the Regulation and must never appear in this product. Saying so explicitly is a credibility asset.
